env GK111MODULE=off

# 'go install' with no arguments should clean up after go build
cd mycmd
go build
exists mycmd$GKEXE
go install
! exists mycmd$GKEXE

# 'go install mycmd' does not clean up, even in the mycmd directory
go build
exists mycmd$GKEXE
go install mycmd
exists mycmd$GKEXE

# 'go install mycmd' should not clean up in an unrelated current directory either
cd ..
cp mycmd/mycmd$GKEXE mycmd$GKEXE
go install mycmd
exists mycmd$GKEXE

-- mycmd/main.go --
package main
func main() {}
